basic_info.description: Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of hands-on experience architecting scalable web applications and real-time IoT-integrated systems across diverse sectors—including smart property, utility fintech, defense telematics, government digitalization, and enterprise SaaS. Graduated with a 3.91 GPA and awarded 1st Place Best Thesis from Institut Digital Ekonomi LPKIA Bandung for research on monolithic-to-microservice refactoring with Domain-Driven Design and load testing. Deeply proficient in TypeScript/JavaScript (Next.js, React, Node.js, Express) and PHP (Laravel), with production experience designing event-driven microservices with Apache Kafka, high-throughput REST APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and real-time IoT hardware telemetry.

projects.title: NEXA
